summary: Citizens Community Bancorp filed an 8-K announcing a new share repurchase authorization approved by its Board on September 2, 2026. The authorization permits the repurchase of up to 482,500 shares through September 1, 2027, replacing the July 2025 authorization under which 112,867 shares remained available at its July 23, 2026 expiration. Repurchases may occur on the open market under Rule 10b-18, potentially via Rule 10b5-1 trading plans. Management determines timing and amounts based on price, market conditions, and investment opportunities. The authorization is discretionary and may be amended or terminated without notice. What to watch: actual buyback pace versus prior authorizations.
